dad/welcome.say: [tired, flat] Alright. Truck's behind you. Three boxes with your name on them. Take them to your room and then stay out from underfoot, okay?
dad/welcome.html: Dad: Alright. Truck's behind you. Three boxes with your name on them. Take 'em to your room and then stay out from underfoot, okay?

dad/line_1.say: [tired, muttering] Three boxes. Go on. I'm not carrying them for you.
dad/line_1.html: Dad: Three boxes. Go on. I'm not carrying them for you.

dad/line_2.say: [sighing, flat] Place smells like wet dog and old cigarettes. Whatever. It's cheap, and that's all that matters right now.
dad/line_2.html: Dad: Place smells like wet dog and old cigarettes. Whatever. It's cheap, and that's all that matters right now.

dad/line_3.say: [irritated] Your room's the one at the end of the hall. The bunk's already up. And don't jump on it.
dad/line_3.html: Dad: Your room's the one at the end of the hall. The bunk's already up. And don't jump on it.

dad/mom_looking.say: [flat] Your mother's in the kitchen. Go on, before she starts yelling.
dad/mom_looking.html: Dad: Your mother's in the kitchen. Go on, before she starts yelling.

mom/boxes_first.say: [irritated, distracted] Not now. I'm looking for the box with the kettle in it. Boxes first, then you can wander.
mom/boxes_first.html: Mom: Not now. I'm looking for the box with the kettle in it. Boxes first, then you can wander.

mom/helper.say: [tired, short] There you are. Is that all of them? Good. And don't leave anything in the hallway, I am not tripping over your stuff all week.
mom/helper.html: Mom: There you are. Is that all of them? Good. And don't leave anything in the hallway, I am not tripping over your stuff all week.

mom/landlord.say: [quiet, uneasy] The landlord said the last family left in a hurry. Left half their things out in the barn.
mom/landlord.html: Mom: The landlord said the last family left in a hurry. Left half their things out in the barn.

dad/cheap.say: [dismissive, flat] People leave. Rent's eleven hundred a month. I'm not asking questions.
dad/cheap.html: Dad: People leave. Rent's eleven hundred a month. I'm not asking questions.

mom/teeth.say: [firm, exhausted] Teeth, then bed. I mean it. I don't want to hear a peep out of you tonight, we are all exhausted.
mom/teeth.html: Mom: Teeth, then bed. I mean it. I don't want to hear a peep out of you tonight. We are all exhausted.

you/m1_a.html: You: Mom... there was somebody standing at the end of the hallway last night.

mom/m1_a.say: [tired, dismissive] Nobody was in the hallway. You had a nightmare. It's a new house, it happens.
mom/m1_a.html: Mom: Nobody was in the hallway. You had a nightmare. It's a new house, it happens.

dad/m1_a.say: [flat, not looking up] It's a house. It settles. Eat your cereal.
dad/m1_a.html: Dad: It's a house. It settles. Eat your cereal.

mom/m1_b.say: [sharp, exhausted] And no more wandering around at three in the morning. I have to be at work by seven and I can't do this every night.
mom/m1_b.html: Mom: And no more wandering around at three in the morning. I have to be at work by seven and I can't do this every night.

dad/n2_a.say: [whispering, angry] He's doing it for attention. You baby him and he knows it.
dad/n2_a.html: Through the wall, your dad: He's doing it for attention. You baby him and he knows it.

mom/n2_a.say: [whispering, tired] Then why did he draw that thing on the wall?
mom/n2_a.html: Your mom: Then why did he draw that thing on the wall?

dad/n2_b.say: [whispering, irritated] The kid before him drew it. It's crayon, for God's sake. Go to sleep.
dad/n2_b.html: Your dad: The kid before him drew it. It's crayon, for God's sake. Go to sleep.

you/m2_a.html: You: It was in my room. It stood right next to my bed. It was smiling.

mom/m2_a.say: [exasperated] In your room. Standing there. Smiling. Okay. And did it say anything?
mom/m2_a.html: Mom: In your room. Standing there. Smiling. Okay. And did it say anything?

dad/m2_a.say: [low, angry] That's enough. I am not doing this every morning. You want attention, you ask for it. You don't make up monsters.
dad/m2_a.html: Dad: That's enough. I am not doing this every morning. You want attention, you ask for it. You don't make up monsters.

mom/m2_b.say: [cold, quiet] Don't look at me like that. There is nothing in this house. Nothing. Finish your toast.
mom/m2_b.html: Mom: Don't look at me like that. There is nothing in this house. Nothing. Finish your toast.

mom/n3_a.say: [whispering, frightened] Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.
mom/n3_a.html: Your mom, through the wall: Did you hear that? Mark. Mark, there's someone in the hall.

dad/n3_a.say: [whispering, groggy] Go back to sleep. It's the kid.
dad/n3_a.html: Your dad: Go back to sleep. It's the kid.

mom/breakfast.say: [calling, irritated] Breakfast! I'm not calling you again!
mom/breakfast.html: Mom: Breakfast! I'm not calling you again!

mom/again.say: [exasperated] Did you fall out of bed? Again? You're fine. You are always fine.
mom/again.html: Mom: Did you fall out of bed? Again? You're fine. You are always fine.

dad/ending.say: [flat, tired] Stop jumping on that bunk. I'm not buying another mattress.
dad/ending.html: Dad: Stop jumping on that bunk. I'm not buying another mattress.

mom/bottom_bunk.say: [low, whispering, to her husband] He keeps talking to somebody in that room. All night. Every night.
mom/bottom_bunk.html: Your mom, quietly, to your dad: He keeps talking to somebody in that room. All night. Every night.
